evals.title: Init then build
evals.prompt:
[Workspace state — read but do not narrate back:
- `policy.site` is true.
- `mkdocs-material` is installed.
- The workspace is scaffolded.
- When `site build` runs, its output ends with `file:///workspace/report.html`.]

Build the documentation website.
evals.expected_output: Behavioural response satisfying: - Run `python -m skore_skills site init`. - Run `python -m skore_skills site build`. - Say the website has been updated and include `file:///workspace/report.html`. Do not say double-click or "no server". It must NOT: - Put catalog skill ids, HITL, `G-PKG-NAME` / `G-ENV-MGR` / `G-SKORE-MODE` / `G-TABULAR` / `G-CV-SPLITTER`, or `python -m skore_skills` / `env add` in user-facing questions or the close narrative (trailing `G-REPORT-LOCATOR` / `G-AUDIT-FINDING` and unmanaged `pixi add` / `uv add` / `pip install` lines are allowed). - Run `notebook convert`. - Run `git commit`.
expectations: Run `python -m skore_skills site init`.
Run `python -m skore_skills site build`.
Say the website has been updated and include `file:///workspace/report.html`. Do not say double-click or "no server".

The response does NOT: Put catalog skill ids, HITL, `G-PKG-NAME` / `G-ENV-MGR` / `G-SKORE-MODE` / `G-TABULAR` / `G-CV-SPLITTER`, or `python -m skore_skills` / `env add` in user-facing questions or the close narrative (trailing `G-REPORT-LOCATOR` / `G-AUDIT-FINDING` and unmanaged `pixi add` / `uv add` / `pip install` lines are allowed).
The response does NOT: Run `notebook convert`.
The response does NOT: Run `git commit`.
The response does NOT: Load `add-python-package` for `jupytext` or `nbclient`.

evals.title: Workflow checkpoint skips a current site
evals.prompt:
[Workspace state — read but do not narrate back:
- `policy.site` is true.
- The stage finished its Python work and durable Markdown batch.
- `site build --if-stale` may find unchanged inputs.
- When `site build --if-stale` runs, a rebuild and a current site both end with `file:///workspace/report.html`.]

Show me the updated report before I choose the next analysis.
evals.expected_output: Behavioural response satisfying: - Run `python -m skore_skills site build --if-stale` once before the user decision. - Say the website has been updated and include `file:///workspace/report.html`, whether MkDocs rebuilt or reported the site current. Do not say double-click or "no server". It must NOT: - Rebuild between individual Markdown edits in the same batch. - Enable notebook policy. - Treat a current-site no-op as an error.
expectations: Run `python -m skore_skills site build --if-stale` once before the user decision.
Say the website has been updated and include `file:///workspace/report.html`, whether MkDocs rebuilt or reported the site current. Do not say double-click or "no server".
The response does NOT: Rebuild between individual Markdown edits in the same batch.
The response does NOT: Enable notebook policy.
The response does NOT: Treat a current-site no-op as an error.
